subject: ShopDash renewal — benchmark kickoff & trial terms
messages:
From: Olivia Turner <olivia.turner@shopdash.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>
Date: 2027-07-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: ShopDash renewal evaluation

Hi Laura,

We're coming up on our renewal and the execs have asked us to review options — a competitor (BakeCo) has approached us with a lower price and a benchmark document that claims 30% lower P95 latency on our workload. Before we go deeper, can you:

- Confirm whether Redwood can supply a concise benchmark plan we can run (or that you can run) to compare head-to-head.
- Share an updated renewal quote with a couple of term/commitment options.

We're keen to avoid a long bakeoff, but procurement has flagged this as a risk. If you can respond with a trial/kickoff plan by early next week we'll share with our procurement and infra teams.

Thanks,
Olivia
Olivia Turner
Head of Platform Engineering
ShopDash

Attachment: competitor-claim.pdf (report, 2 pages)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>
To: Olivia Turner <olivia.turner@shopdash.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference>
Date: 2027-07-26T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ShopDash renewal evaluation

Hi Olivia — thanks for the heads up and the report.

We can absolutely run a short, tightly scoped benchmark and/or give you a two-week dedicated trial on a reserved pool that mirrors your production profile. Proposed approach (high level):

- 10 business-day plan: 2 days of workload intake + 5 days of side-by-side runs + 3 days of analysis and incident replay.
- Offer: one-time trial pricing for a 2-week dedicated pool (2x your current reserved capacity) and a draft 1- or 2-year term quote with an upfront commitment discount.
- Deliverables: benchmark results (P50/P95/P99), cost delta analysis, suggested model/quantization profile.

Can you share a representative request trace or a 5–10 minute production trace, and connect us with the procurement contact so we can include them in the quote? I've attached a short benchmark plan and pricing worksheet for review.

If that sounds good I'll loop in Rishi to confirm ops feasibility and Priyom for commercial options.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Account Executive, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-benchmark-plan.pdf, shopdash-price-worksheet.xlsx

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.inference>
Date: 2027-07-27T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: FW: ShopDash renewal evaluation — action items

Folks,

Forwarding Olivia's note. Quick internal ask:

- Ops: can we commit to a 2-week dedicated trial with 2x reserved capacity and run side-by-side P95 measurements? Any blockers on providing a performance credit if we miss the agreed SLO?
- Commercial: recommend we offer a 10% commit discount on a 2-year extension (trade for capacity guarantee), plus one free month and priority onboarding for the trial.

I'll calibrate the messaging with procurement, but we need a firm bench plan and a short SLA we can include in a DocuSign packet. Priyom — can you draft 1yr/2yr pricing options and a sample SLA? Markus — please confirm whether we can expedite a quantized model build for ShopDash's trace (should help with latency claims).

Thanks — fast turnaround appreciated, Olivia wants a kickoff early next week.

— Laura

Attachment: ops-trial-playbook.md

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference>
Date: 2027-07-29T09:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FW: ShopDash renewal evaluation — action items

Laura,

We can do the 2-week dedicated pool and run a side-by-side with BakeCo's supplied workload. Operational notes:

- Proposed SLO for the trial: P95 <= 120ms for inference (your trace / 99 tokens); cost-to-serve reported per 1M tokens.
- Risk mitigation: if we miss P95 target by more than 20% on two consecutive test days, we'll provide a 30% service credit for the trial period (documented in the SLA).
- Quantized model: Markus's team can produce a q4_0 variant optimized for the ShopDash trace within 4 business days after we receive the trace.
- Need: a sanitized 5–10 minute trace + sample prompt set and expected output correctness checks.

I'll coordinate with infra on a dedicated pool spin-up window — earliest is Monday. Priyom, happy to sync on precise pricing impacts.

— Rishi

From: Olivia Turner <olivia.turner@shopdash.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>
Cc: ShopDash Procurement <procurement@shopdash.com>
Date: 2027-08-01T14:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ShopDash renewal evaluation

Hi Laura,

Thanks — that approach sounds reasonable. Procurement wants a short bakeoff rules doc and a clear SLA before we start. Can you also include:

- A one-page summary of the trial rules (what we'll run, tie-breakers for performance vs. cost).
- DocuSign-ready agreement for the trial and for the 2-year commitment option (we can sign quickly if procurement likes the terms).

I've attached the competitor's benchmark for reference. Please include procurement on the DocuSign and scheduling emails: procurement@shopdash.com

We'll aim to kick off Monday if we have the rules and DocuSign in hand.

Regards,
Olivia

Attachment: competitor-claim.pdf (already supplied)
